title: SREV-120 Terminal user token session contract

wire_shape.description: GET_USER_TOKEN_REQ carries the requested WTS session id

service_gate.description: TerminalServer validates requested session against the caller session

runtime_matrix.description: Windows WTSQueryUserToken and DuplicateHandle runtime proof

contracts: WTSQueryUserToken is keyed by an explicit Remote Desktop Services SessionId
Terminal_WTSQueryUserToken must forward the caller requested SessionId in GET_USER_TOKEN_REQ
TerminalServer GetUserToken validates the full GET_USER_TOKEN_REQ size
TerminalServer only satisfies the request when requested session equals the SbieApi_QueryProcess caller session
TerminalServer calls WTSQueryUserToken with the validated requested session id
token filtering OriginalToken UnfilteredToken DuplicateHandle and close-handle ownership are unchanged
